conceptCards.title: Addition foundations
conceptCards.summary: Combine quantities fluently by grouping convenient values.
conceptCards.commonMistake: When compensating, move the same amount between addends rather than adding it twice.
conceptCards.application: Use compensation to check totals, prices, and estimates mentally.

hints.conceptCue: Move an amount from one addend to the other without changing the total.
hints.methodCue: Make one addend a multiple of ten.

conceptCards.title: Subtraction foundations
conceptCards.summary: Find differences accurately while preserving the shown order.
conceptCards.commonMistake: Do not reverse the operands merely because the second number is easier to handle first.
conceptCards.application: Use equal adjustment to check change, movement, and differences mentally.

hints.conceptCue: Adding the same amount to both numbers preserves their difference.
hints.methodCue: Adjust the subtrahend to a multiple of ten.

conceptCards.title: Multiplication foundations
conceptCards.summary: Break products into familiar multiples using distribution.
conceptCards.commonMistake: Distribute the multiplier to every part before recombining the partial products.
conceptCards.application: Use decomposition for quantities, rates, areas, and quick scaling estimates.

hints.conceptCue: Split one factor into parts whose products you know.
